name: trackdesk
description: Manage your Trackdesk affiliate program from Claude: performance reports, affiliate and conversion reviews, and affiliate payouts through the Trackdesk MCP server.

tenant_id.title: Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: The subdomain your program runs on: for https://acme.trackdesk.com enter acme.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Leave empty to sign in with your Trackdesk account (OAuth). Set a personal access token from Settings → Integrations → Personal access tokens only where a browser sign-in is not possible.
